notable_absence.finding: PAM and saslauthd have been namable only parenthetically, inside auth-domain:external's own description, for many prior rounds ('LDAP, SAML, PAM'); this is the first round to extract a page tree ('manage/manage-security/') dedicated to actually configuring them, hence the first-time minting of idp:pam and idp:saslauthd as their own concepts.

cross_component_finding: This overview page's own bullet list names SEVEN top-level security system-areas (Networked access, Authentication, Authorization, Auditing, Certificates, Logs, Sessions) - broader than the 4-facility framing (Authentication/Authorization/Auditing/Encryption) already recorded elsewhere in the registry against security:authentication. 'Sessions' had no covering concept, hence security:session-management minted here and reused in manage-sessions.md and manage-security-settings.md.
cross_product_finding: The security checklist table's 'Access control' row includes 'Implement Multi-Factor Authentication for individual access' as a generic Server best-practice recommendation, but no page in this batch (or, per the registry excerpt, elsewhere) describes an actual Server-side MFA mechanism - the only promoted auth:mfa concept is explicitly scoped '(Capella)'. Left this unminted for Server rather than merge it with Capella's auth:mfa, since the checklist bullet names the practice but not a mechanism; flagging for reconciliation in case a Server MFA feature page exists outside this batch.
